title: People Finder
description: Find people at a company by role, seniority, and department. Provide a domain, company name, or LinkedIn company URL. Returns structured contact records with LinkedIn URL, normalized seniority and department, and optional verified email. Free Apify-plan users get 50 people per calendar month (resets monthly); upgrade for unlimited: https://apify.com/pricing?fpr=mamba

domain.title: Company Domain
domain.description: Bare domain without https:// or trailing slash. Example: stripe.com

company_name.title: Company Name (optional)
company_name.description: Used when no domain is available, or as a disambiguation hint alongside a domain.

linkedin_company_url.title: LinkedIn Company URL (optional)
linkedin_company_url.description: Example: https://www.linkedin.com/company/stripe. Skips internal company resolution when provided.

domains.title: Company Domains (batch)
domains.description: Optional list of bare domains. Takes precedence over the single domain field. Each domain is searched independently and every output row echoes its source domain.

targetCount.title: People Per Company
targetCount.description: Maximum people to return per company. Billing is per person actually returned, so a lower number is a hard cost cap.

jobTitles.title: Job Titles To Include
jobTitles.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the person's current title. Any match qualifies. Leave empty for no title filter. Example: VP Sales, Head of Growth

excludeJobTitles.title: Job Titles To Exclude
excludeJobTitles.description: Case-insensitive substring match. A person matching any of these is dropped even if they matched an include. Example: intern, assistant, former

seniority.title: Seniority Levels
seniority.description: Filter to these normalized seniority levels. Leave empty for all.

departments.title: Departments
departments.description: Filter to these normalized departments. Leave empty for all.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes. Filters to people located in these countries. Example: US, GB, NL

includeEmails.title: Find Email Addresses
includeEmails.description: Discover a business email for each person found, using your Icypeas and/or Prospeo keys. Billed only when an email is actually returned. Turn off to build an org map cheaply.

verifyEmails.title: Verify Email Addresses
verifyEmails.description: Check deliverability of each email found, escalating catch-all domains to a second provider for a definitive answer. Requires a Reoon and/or BounceBan key.

verifyPosition.title: Verify Position Is Current
verifyPosition.description: Check that the person still holds the returned title at the target company, and report the reasoning. Reduces bounced outreach to people who have moved on.

suppressLinkedInUrls.title: Suppress These LinkedIn URLs
suppressLinkedInUrls.description: LinkedIn profile URLs to exclude from results. Use to suppress already-contacted prospects or honor data subject removal requests.

batchSize.title: Batch Size
batchSize.description: How many companies to search concurrently in batch mode. Default 5, maximum 10.

skipCache.title: Skip Cache
skipCache.description: Results are cached for 7 days and reused on repeat lookups. Set true to force a fresh search.

serpApiKey.title: Search API Key (optional)
serpApiKey.description: Serper.dev API key. Unlocks the search layer, which is the highest-coverage source of LinkedIn profile URLs. Without it this actor falls back to company website parsing only, which returns far fewer people. Get a key at https://serper.dev. You are billed by Serper for searches; this actor does not mark them up.

prospeoApiKey.title: Prospeo API Key (optional)
prospeoApiKey.description: Second provider in the email waterfall. Used only for people the first provider could not resolve. Get a key at https://prospeo.io. Billed to you by Prospeo; this actor does not mark it up.

reoonApiKey.title: Reoon API Key (optional)
reoonApiKey.description: Primary email verification. Returns deliverability status for each discovered address. Get a key at https://emailverifier.reoon.com. Billed to you by Reoon.

bounceBanApiKey.title: BounceBan API Key (optional)
bounceBanApiKey.description: Catch-all resolution. Used only when the primary verifier returns catch-all or risky, to determine whether that specific mailbox exists. Get a key at https://bounceban.com. Billed to you by BounceBan.

icypeasApiKey.title: Icypeas API Key (optional)
icypeasApiKey.description: Optional. Only used for the licensed-database fallback layer, which runs when the company website and public search results do not yield enough people. Leave empty to skip that layer entirely; the run still succeeds and reports any shortfall in the summary.

claudeApiKey.title: Claude API Key (optional)
claudeApiKey.description: Optional. Only used to classify job titles that the built-in rule table cannot place into a seniority and department. One batched call per run, never per person. Leave empty to leave those two fields null on the affected rows.

source_tag.title: Source Tag
source_tag.description: Internal attribution tag set by Mamba Labs on published task examples. Not required, and nothing depends on it. Leave it empty.
